event_data.context: Roadmap ticket 2. Remove unsupported Codex-boundary machinery and global configuration writes, make plugin authority explicitly advisory, fix MCP startup to resolve from the installed plugin root, preserve reusable EventCore/Tiber Tasks/workflow/eval code, regenerate release artifacts, and prove ordinary Codex can inspect, edit, verify, commit, and push.
event_data.summary: Reduce the development-system plugin to an advisory, repository-local bootstrap; preserve reusable EventCore, Tiber Tasks, workflow, and eval services; fix installed-root MCP startup; remove unsupported Codex-boundary enforcement and global configuration mutation.
event_data.title: Ship a reliable bootstrap plugin for Tiber development
